rows.note: Use this as the broad abstract term for diversity in society, culture, viewpoints, or other areas.

example.english: Residents from different backgrounds make this community a good example of social diversity.
example.traditional: 呢個社區有唔同背景嘅居民，充分體現社會多元化。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 se5 keoi1 jau5 m4 tung4 bui3 ging2 ge3 geoi1 man4 cung1 fan6 tai2 jin6 se5 wui2 do1 jyun4 faa3

rows.note: Use this when sense 0 focuses on the differences between things rather than variety as a whole.

example.english: Compare their approaches and you will see the diversity between them.
example.traditional: 比較下佢哋嘅做法，就會睇到當中嘅分別。
example.jyutping: bei2 gaau3 haa5 keoi5 dei6 ge3 zou6 faat3 zau6 wui5 tai2 dou2 dong1 zung1 ge3 fan1 bit6

rows.jyutping: gok3 zung2 gok3 joeng6 ge3 N
rows.note: Use this casual construction for a concrete range of different types or examples, such as 各種各樣嘅意見.

example.english: At the meeting, everyone put forward all kinds of opinions, showing the diversity of views.
example.traditional: 會上大家提出各種各樣嘅意見，討論好熱烈。
example.jyutping: wui6 soeng5 daai6 gaa1 tai4 ceot1 gok3 zung2 gok3 joeng6 ge3 ji3 gin3 tou2 leon6 hou2 jit6 lit6
